content.intro: J/kg, kJ/kg, BTU/lb. Convert between 5 fuel efficiency (mass) units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for fuel efficiency (mass) in this tool is **Jkg**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most fuel efficiency (mass) conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.

content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
